item.title: Micron says it has reached agreement with Taiwan union
item.description: Micron Technology said on Wednesday that it had reached a labour-management agreement with the Taichung union in Taiwan, with both parties agreeing to withdraw from the mediation process that had been scheduled for October 22.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Micron Technology said on Wednesday that it had reached a labour-management agreement with the Taichung union in Taiwan, with both parties agreeing to withdraw from the mediation process that had been scheduled for October 22. Idaho-based Micron employs about 15,000 people in Taiwan.

item.title: 中国、ＣＯＰ３１でクリーンテック関税に対抗へ
item.description:
Lewis Jackson
[北京 ２１日 ロイター] - 中国は来月トルコで開催される国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Lewis Jackson

[北京 ２１日 ロイター] - 中国は来月トルコで開催される国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１） について、中国のクリーンテックに対する関税問題に焦点を当てることを望んでいる。

生態環境省の李高次官は２１日の記者会見で、ＣＯＰ３１では、開発途上国への気候資金支援といった問題に加え、単独行動主義や保護主義という「新たな問題」にも取り組むべきだと述べた。

中国は、排出削減に必要な太陽光パネル、風力タービン、バッテリー、電気自動車の生産において、他を圧倒する世界最大の生産国。しかし、自国産業への競争上の影響を懸念する国々からは、こうした技術が「機会」ではなく「脅威」として見なされるようになってきている。

米国は中国の太陽光パネルや電気自動車に高関税を課しており、欧州連合（ＥＵ）も自動車に対して同様の措置を講じ、一部の太陽光部品に制限を課しているほか、中国の主要な風力発電関連企業を不公正貿易の疑いで調査している。

李氏は、地政学的対立が「激化」する中、ＣＯＰ３１ではグリーン技術の自由な流通について議論すべきだと指摘。中国に対する中傷や攻撃に対しては「断固たる対応」を取るとした。

item.title: UK borrows more than expected again, debt hits £3 trillion
item.description: Britain's government borrowed more than expected again in September and public debt surpassed £3 trillion ($4.01 trillion), according to official data that underscored finance minister John Healey's challenge in his first budget next week.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's government borrowed more than expected again in September and public debt surpassed £3 trillion ($4.01 trillion), according to official data that underscored finance minister John Healey's challenge in his first budget next week. Borrowing hit £24.52 billion last month, pushed up by spending on debt interest. A Reuters poll of economists had pointed to a deficit of £23.85 billion in the month. Over the first six months of the 2026/27 financial year, the shortfall stood at £97.8 billion, down by £4.4 billion from a year earlier but above the forecast of £91.8 billion made by the Office for Budget Responsibility before the Iran war began. Healey is expected to raise taxes on banks among other measures on October 28 in order to stay on track to meet his fiscal rules. However, his margin for error is expected to have narrowed sharply in large part due to the rise in borrowing costs for government debt around the world since the start of the conflict in the Gulf. Wednesday's data showed public sector debt was estimated to have exceeded £3 trillion for the first time. However, as a proportion of the economy, debt was lower than a year earlier, the Office for National Statistics said. ($1 = 0.7481 pounds)

item.title: 三菱商、米銅鉱山プロジェクトに追加拠出 総投資額1526億円
item.description: [東京 ２１日 ロイター] - 三菱商事は２１日、カナダの資源会社ハドベイ・ミネラルズと共同で進める米国アリゾナ州の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
三菱商、米銅鉱山プロジェクトに追加拠出　総投資額1526億円 15:17 配信

[東京 ２１日 ロイター] - 三菱商事は２１日、カナダの資源会社ハドベイ・ミネラルズと共同で進める米国アリゾナ州の銅鉱山プロジェクトについて、開発を本格化させるために新たに約６５６億円を拠出すると発表した。投資総額は約１５２６億円となる。

・昨年８月の時に権益対価約６１０億円・開発費約２６０億円の拠出を決定済み

・２０２９年下期に生産開始予定、年間約１０万トンの銅生産を見込む

・持分比率は三菱商事３０％、ハドベイ・ミネラルズ７０％

・持分銅生産量を３０年度以降に現在の約３３万トンから４０万トン超へ拡大

・生成ＡＩ・データセンター拡大など米国の電力需要増を背景に銅需要の成長を見込む

・日米政府の重要鉱物サプライチェーン強化政策とも整合するプロジェクト目指す

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 コラム：日米協調介入が告げる円高への転換、円安派は今こそ見直しの時 最終更新: 10/21(水) 15:17 ロイター

item.title: Musk bestätigt Gespräche über Fusion von Tesla und SpaceX
item.description: Tech-Milliardär Elon Musk hat erstmals formelle Gespräche über eine mögliche Fusion seiner beiden Unternehmen Tesla und SpaceX bestätigt. Er finde einen Zusammenschluss "eine gute Idee", sagte er in einer Telefonkonferenz mit Investoren zu den zuvor veröffentlichten SpaceX-Quartalszahlen in der Nacht zum Dienstag. Entsprechende Sonderausschüsse seien gebildet worden, um eine mögliche Fusion zu prüfen. Die Aktien des Raumfahrt- und Technologiekonzerns SpaceX, der zuvor seinen ersten Gewinn als börsennotiertes Unternehmen ausgewiesen hatte, stiegen im nachbörslichen Handel um acht Prozent. Die Tesla-Papiere legten um 1,8 Prozent zu.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tech-Milliardär Elon Musk hat erstmals formelle Gespräche über eine mögliche Fusion seiner beiden Unternehmen Tesla (TSLA.O) und SpaceX (SPCX.O) bestätigt. Er finde einen Zusammenschluss "eine gute Idee", sagte er in einer Telefonkonferenz mit Investoren zu den zuvor veröffentlichten SpaceX-Quartalszahlen in der Nacht zum Dienstag. Entsprechende Sonderausschüsse seien gebildet worden, um eine mögliche Fusion zu prüfen. Die Aktien des Raumfahrt- und Technologiekonzerns SpaceX, der zuvor seinen ersten Gewinn als börsennotiertes Unternehmen ausgewiesen hatte, stiegen im nachbörslichen Handel um acht Prozent. Die Tesla-Papiere legten um 1,8 Prozent zu. "Ich denke, es wäre eine gute Idee, aber das liegt wirklich an den Sonderausschüssen beider Unternehmen", sagte Musk. Da er selbst in einem Interessenkonflikt stehe, könne er an den Gesprächen der aus unabhängigen Direktoren bestehenden Gremien nicht teilnehmen. Die Ausschüsse seien auf Wunsch der Aktionäre eingerichtet worden, die einem Geschäft letztlich zustimmen müssten. Es sei jedoch verfrüht, von einer Fusion auszugehen. Die Ausschüsse hätten sich noch nicht auf die Bedingungen einer Transaktion geeinigt und würden das möglicherweise auch nie tun. Einem Insider zufolge begannen die Gespräche in den vergangenen Wochen und könnten in einer Übernahme von Tesla durch SpaceX münden. Der Elektroautobauer lasse sich dabei von einer Investmentbank beraten, sagte die mit dem Vorgang vertraute Person der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Musk ist der reichste Mensch der Welt und besitzt knapp ein Fünftel von Tesla sowie knapp die Hälfte von SpaceX. Analysten zufolge würde ihm eine Fusion die Kontrolle über das kombinierte Unternehmen sichern. Musk verwies auf die großen Vorteile einer Zusammenarbeit bei der Entwicklung etwa von Superintelligenz-Software, Chipdesign und Robotik. Das gemeinsame Chip-Produktionsunternehmen Terafab solle im Mai oder Juni kommenden Jahres einen ersten Test-Chip herstellen und bis zum dritten Quartal 2028 die Massenproduktion erreichen.

item.title: Malaysia bans civil servants from using mapping app Waze, citing links to Israel
item.description: Malaysia has banned civil servants from using Alphabet's navigation app Waze after Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said its origins in Israel raised security concerns.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Malaysia has banned civil servants from using Alphabet's navigation app Waze after Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said its origins in Israel raised security concerns. Muslim-majority Malaysia is a staunch supporter of the Palestinian cause and does not maintain diplomatic relations with Israel. Anwar said on Tuesday that the government was looking into potential security risks arising from the use of Waze, which he said "was bound to Israeli laws." "We cannot compromise on the security of people's data and identities," he said in a Facebook post after chairing a national cybersecurity committee meeting. Anwar did not provide any details of the risks but recommended the use of TuJu, a domestic mapping app developed by the Malaysian Highway Authority, as an alternative. Malaysia's Chief Secretary to the Government Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar said all civil servants would now be barred from using Waze, according to a letter dated Tuesday and addressed to the heads of government agencies. The letter, reviewed by Reuters, said the directive followed a decision taken at the meeting chaired by Anwar, with the prohibition to take effect immediately. An official with the Prime Minister's Department confirmed the letter's authenticity. Waze, which was founded in Israel, uses satellite signals and crowd-sourced data from drivers to offer real-time traffic information. It was acquired by Alphabet-owned Google in 2013 for about $1 billion.

item.title: US envoy Witkoff arrives in St Petersburg for talks with Putin
item.description: US special envoy Steve Witkoff arrived on Wednesday in Russia's second-largest city of St Petersburg where he is set to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin for talks aimed at resolving the war in Ukraine, two sources with the visit told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US special envoy Steve Witkoff arrived on Wednesday in Russia's second-largest city of St Petersburg where he is set to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin for talks aimed at resolving the war in Ukraine , two sources with the visit told Reuters. He will hold talks in the former Russian imperial capital a day after [USN:L6N467096 TEXT:"meeting"] Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy in Oslo. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Witkoff's meeting with Zelenskiy was [USN:L6N467096 TEXT:"positive"] and that Witkoff would share the results with Russia.

item.title: One killed, two injured in attack on Russia's Bryansk region, governor says
item.description: A 19-year old man was killed and two people were wounded in a Ukrainian drone attack on a car in Russia's western Bryansk region, the governor, Yegor Kovalchuk said on Telegram on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A 19-year old man was killed and two people were wounded in a Ukrainian drone attack on a car in Russia's western Bryansk region, the governor, Yegor Kovalchuk said on Telegram on Wednesday. Reuters could not independently verify the claim.

item.title: Adidas shares rise after 2026 guidance hike
item.description: Adidas shares are seen rising 3.3% in Lang & Schwarz premarket indications early on Wednesday, after the German sportswear firm reported strong third-quarter results and raised its full-year outlook on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Adidas (ADSGn.DE) shares are seen rising 3.3% in Lang & Schwarz premarket indications early on Wednesday, after the German sportswear firm reported [USN:L6N46614U TEXT:"strong third-quarter results"] and raised its full-year outlook on Tuesday. Adidas said it expected its annual operating profit to be around €100 million ($112 million) higher than previously expected. ($1 = 0.8910 euros)

item.title: UK inflation picks up more than expected to 3.5% in September
item.description: Britain's annual rate of consumer price inflation rose more than expected to 3.5% in September from 3.1% in August, official figures showed on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's annual rate of consumer price inflation rose more than expected to 3.5% in September from 3.1% in August, official figures showed on Wednesday. A Reuters poll of economists had shown a median forecast of a rise in consumer price inflation to 3.4% as the surge in energy prices caused by the Iran war intensified last month. The BoE predicted a smaller rise to 3.0% in forecasts it published in July. Britain has been more affected than most Western countries by the war in the Gulf due to its heavy reliance on imported natural gas. The BoE has said the energy price shock has had a limited impact on broader British inflation so far but Governor Andrew Bailey and other policymakers have also said the likelihood of a rate hike is growing the longer energy prices stay elevated. Investors expect the central bank to raise its benchmark Bank Rate to 4% next month, the first increase in three years. It has so far kept policy on hold since the outbreak of the US-Iran war in February. Figures released on Tuesday [USN:L8N46608R TEXT:"showed signs of stabilisation"] in the labour market, potentially adding to the case for a rate hike by the BoE next month. Wednesday's inflation data release comes a week before finance minister John Healey's first budget when he is expected to offer some further support for households hit hardest by the jump in energy prices.

item.title: Europe weighs giving utilities, infrastructure companies more powers to bring down drones
item.description: At a former flight-test base south of Paris, drones swoop over fields and woodland as teams on the ground test systems designed to stop them — a response to a growing wave of drone incursions and hybrid attacks since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022.
item.dc:creator: Maria Rugamer, Leo Marchandon, Marek Strzelecki, Florence Loeve
item.content:encoded: At a former flight-test base south of Paris, drones swoop over fields and woodland as teams on the ground test systems designed to stop them — a response to a growing wave of drone incursions and [USN:L8N45R0NV TEXT:""hybrid attacks""] since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022. The potential clients for technology such as electronic jammers and interceptor drones tested at the Brétigny-sur-Orge site are no longer just governments, police and armies. Private firms and state entities across Europe that operate critical infrastructure want to strengthen their defences, with some utilities asking for authorisation to shoot drones down themselves. From Paris to Berlin, governments are taking note. They are worried that [USN:L8N45F1L2 TEXT:"hybrid warfare"] or a drone attack could knock out power to millions of people — as has happened frequently in [USN:L1N4620A4 TEXT:"Ukraine"] after Russian strikes. "It is a theoretical, and increasingly a practical, possibility that there could be heating outages this winter due to hybrid attacks," Kristian Ruby, secretary general of European energy body Eurelectric, told Reuters. Some European governments are responding by starting to give firms powers traditionally confined to the military. Interviews by Reuters with over 30 company executives, officials and drone experts meanwhile show the technology to detect and bring down drones is maturing faster than the rules on who may use it. Approaches vary widely across Europe and legal uncertainties remain, including over who has the right to order a response to a drone threat. Bringing down a drone could cause injury or death to people on the ground or damage property, raising questions for companies about liability and accountability. 'DEFENCELESS' France is among countries that have led the way. Its parliament passed a law in August allowing approved operators of critical infrastructure and contractors to detect, jam and shoot down drones near designated facilities. The law passed by the French parliament in August responded to a wave of [USN:L8N3XF0T2 TEXT:"drone incursions"] over critical and military sites, including flights over the Ile Longue [USN:L8N3XB1AQ TEXT:"nuclear submarine base"] near Brest in northwestern France in December 2025. France wants a newly expanded list of sensitive sites deemed of vital importance equipped by 2027, a senior French official involved in the plans told Reuters, asking not to be named because details of the plan are not yet public. "We were defenceless in the face of the (drone) threat," the official said, adding that concerns had been growing over the last decade as unmanned aerial vehicles became more accessible and more common. The French government wants to give operators of critical infrastructure such as state-owned utility company EDF and state-owned railway company SNCF a catalogue of approved systems ranging from electronic jammers to interceptor drones, depending on different environments and situations. Confirming important elements of the plan outlined by the French official, Systematic Paris-Region, which runs the government testing programme at Brétigny-sur-Orge, said evaluations launched this summer had so far catalogued three systems integrators — which combine different computer systems into a unified whole — and 17 counter-drone systems. It said assessments were continuing and work was under way to accelerate procurement from among those solutions. France's defence ministry said the law passed in August would help strengthen capabilities to counter the threat, though it said it could speak only for the critical infrastructure under its authority. EDF and SNCF declined comment. WHO CAN BRING DOWN A DRONE? The discovery of an explosives-laden drone near a Ukrainian cargo plane at Germany's [USN:L8N44U0IR TEXT:"Leipzig/Halle airport"] in August underlined how far the risks have spread. Germany blamed Russia for the incident. Moscow denied it was behind it, and has repeatedly denied carrying out hybrid attacks in Europe, many of which have been in countries that support Kyiv in Russia's war in Ukraine . But concerns are growing that national authorities cannot respond fast enough to protect widely dispersed infrastructure against such attacks, and that the damage caused by relatively cheap drones could bring hefty repair costs. In [USN:L8N44V0EG TEXT:"Germany"], where counter-drone operations remain a policing function, the interior ministry told Reuters it was reviewing how critical infrastructure operators and third parties could be legally involved in active counter-drone measures. In September, Austria announced plans to give similar powers to critical infrastructure operators, including large energy firms. Defence Minister Klaudia Tanner told a press conference that the state could not protect every site on its own. [USN:L8N4570SQ TEXT:"Poland"] has gone further. Operators told Reuters they have deployed counter-drone systems and trained with military and police units. [USN:L8N4570SQ TEXT:"Drone-restricted zones"] have been established around critical energy infrastructure, and designated security units working for operators have been authorised to destroy, disable or take control of drones entering them. But two sources at energy transmission companies [USN:L1N46400Y TEXT:"on NATO's eastern flank"] told Reuters that effective intervention still requires more assurances, and perhaps a judicial precedent, on who bears responsibility for collateral damage. Without that certainty, they said, operators of critical infrastructure could remain reluctant to neutralise drones because bringing one down could itself cause injury or costly damage. BUILT FOR RECOVERY Having powers to bring down drones would be a change of approach for companies across Europe. Executives, officials and energy analysts told Reuters that utilities have spent years hardening networks and preparing to restore disrupted services, rather than preventing attacks. Leonhard Birnbaum, chief executive of German energy firm E.ON (EONGn.DE) , said in September that operators must assume [USN:L8N4490LF TEXT:"some attacks will succeed"], rather than plan on stopping all of them. The company operates about 2,720 substations across Germany, he said. Lithuania is building a [USN:L8N44H1TR TEXT:"fortified substation"] near its border with Russia as part of plans by the [USN:L8N3X90EA TEXT:"Baltic states and Poland"] to improve their defences that include constructing bunkers, installing anti-drone nets and building up stocks of hard-to-replace equipment for critical parts of the energy grid. Poland's state-owned transmission operator PSE patrols parts of its about 16,500-km (10,250-mile) high-voltage network by helicopter and is preparing more powerful aircraft to help protect an undersea power link to Sweden. Yet relatively inexpensive drones are challenging such defences. Essential equipment such as large transformers can take years to replace, while even a successful repair can leave infrastructure out of service for months. Not all utility operators are seeking a bigger role in defending themselves. Asta Sihvonen-Punkka, chief executive of Finland's national power grid operator Fingrid, told Reuters that responsibility for countering threats around critical infrastructure should remain with Finnish authorities and armed forces. Any move to give such powers to utility operators would be "a very, very big change" requiring careful legal consideration, she said. Jari Stenius, head of security of Finnish utility Fortum (FORTUM.HE) , said he was content for energy companies to focus on producing energy while police and military authorities handled security threats. TECHNOLOGY READY, RULES ARE NOT Security officials and counter-drone technology firms say systems are becoming increasingly automated because operators cannot station specialist teams at every site. Modern counter-drone systems combine sensors, command-and-control software and countermeasures into a single chain designed to identify, classify and respond to threats within seconds. Several companies told Reuters that uncertainty over who can authorise a response has slowed investment in the latter stages of that process. France is therefore trying to automate the process as much as possible, said the senior French official involved in France's plans. The official said security workers at utilities should eventually be able to detect a threat and launch an automated response at the press of a button, because having operators trained to use military-grade solutions at every location was unrealistic. German defence company [USN:L8N42I0D9 TEXT:"Rheinmetall"] (RHMG.DE) told Reuters the biggest hurdle for civilian operators was often the delay between detecting a drone and deciding whether to deploy a countermeasure, as legal responsibilities remain fragmented. Rheinmetall said interest from private infrastructure operators in counter-drone systems was rising sharply. The company said it was conducting workshops, site surveys and infrastructure assessments for operators and was preparing for what it described as a "very fast-growing" market segment.

item.title: Beauty giants target 'Ozempic face' as boom in obesity drugs opens new market
item.description: Swiss skincare firm Galderma , Brazilian cosmetics group Natura and beauty giant L'Oreal are testing treatments for consumers worried about facial sagging and volume loss, looking to capitalise on a growing market tied to the boom in obesity drugs.
item.dc:creator: Richa Naidu, Dominique Patton, Alexander Marrow
item.content:encoded: Swiss skincare firm Galderma (GALD.S) , Brazilian cosmetics group Natura (NATU3m.BA) and beauty giant L'Oreal (OREP.PA) are testing treatments for consumers worried about facial sagging and volume loss, looking to capitalise on a growing market tied to the boom in obesity drugs. The companies are targeting concerns known as "Ozempic face," a term that emerged as the diabetes drug became widely associated with weight loss. Experts say the loss of facial volume is linked to rapid weight loss rather than GLP-1 drugs themselves. GLP-1 drugs, such as Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) Ozempic and Wegovy and Eli Lilly's (LLY.N) Zepbound, help people to lose weight by mimicking a hormone that keeps the stomach feeling full. Along with gastrointestinal side effects, the resulting rapid weight loss can also lead to loose skin on the face and body. Pfizer estimates the obesity drug market could reach $150 billion in annual sales by 2030, helping create a potentially lucrative opportunity for skincare and medical aesthetics companies as more patients seek treatments for skin laxity and facial volume loss after rapid weight loss. Revenue from these clinical treatments is projected to grow from about $700 million to $2 billion over the next five years, according to 2025 estimates by Boston Consulting Group. Michael Somenek, a Washington, DC-based facial plastic surgeon and clinical associate professor at the George Washington University School of Medicine, said he had seen a surge of requests for treatment by GLP-1 patients in the past year. "When you're looking at a large amount of weight loss over four to six months, that can really have impact on the volume within your face," he said. COMPANIES CHASE THE OPPORTUNITY Galderma, 20%-owned by L'Oreal, ran a study last year evaluating how some of its existing treatments perform on skin changes associated with GLP-1 weight-loss drugs. "Sagginess is a concern, loss of firmness is a concern, some hollowness can be of concern and dullness can be a concern," said Anne-Cecile Chevrier, global head of injectable aesthetics at Galderma. The Swiss company makes Sculptra, a treatment that stimulates natural collagen, and Restylane, a dermal filler made with hyaluronic acid. Chevrier said that although the treatments were not approved specifically for GLP-1 users, Galderma is working with tens of thousands of plastic surgeons and other aestheticians globally who market them to patients on weight-loss drugs. In the United States, 53% of aesthetics clinics anticipate an influx of new patients due to prescription weight-loss medications, according to a 2024 report by research firm Medical Insight, and 43% believe the increased use of these medications will drive demand for treatments addressing weight-loss-medication-induced facial changes. L'Oreal is also exploring this market. "We are now testing products on GLP-1 users in separate studies, as this group of consumers is becoming increasingly important and represents a significant number of people worldwide," said Delphine Viguier-Hovasse, L'Oreal's chief innovation and prospective officer. Manuel Krauss, Natura's chief innovation and R&D officer, said the company is testing existing products directly with GLP-1 users and developing a new generation of treatments. "GLP-1 is creating new beauty needs at unprecedented speed, but it is also showing us that the future of beauty cannot be defined by creams alone," Krauss said, noting that future innovation may combine different formats such as supplements and ingestibles. A MORE COMPLICATED PICTURE Other factors can be at play in patients experiencing skin or facial volume issues. According to analysts at the US health policy organisation KFF, GLP-1 drugs are used most widely by adults aged 50 to 64, an age group already experiencing declines in collagen and, particularly among menopausal women, estrogen production. "We don't have the research and it is probably going to be a challenging study to do because most of the female patients (on GLP-1 drugs) are perimenopausal or postmenopausal," said Heidi Young, a Northern California-based physician associate and co-owner of R+H Aesthetic Medicine. She added that some people taking GLP-1 drugs do not eat nutritious food often, which could also affect their skin: "I think it's definitely multifactorial and I don't think there is a direct answer." DO THE PRODUCTS WORK? Beibei Du-Harpur, a consultant dermatologist and clinical lecturer at King’s College London, said the term "Ozempic face" is misleading. “The drug doesn’t melt your collagen — simply losing weight in a more sustainable, less rapid way would reduce some of the more severe changes people see." Experts said some skincare products may improve the appearance and quality of skin affected but cannot fully address the underlying loss of facial volume. "To a certain extent some of these creams can be helpful," said Dr Graeme Glass, plastic and craniofacial surgeon and aesthetic director at British beauty brand LYMA. Creams can work on the epidermis and contain molecules small enough to reach the dermis. "What they can't really do is they can't alter the ligamental structure of your face," he said. "They can't reposition the deep fat pads of the face ... there is a limit to what these things can do." Du-Harpur said beauty companies were "all desperately trying to develop a GLP-1-targeting product." She said treatments such as fillers that use injections worked better than creams as they could reach the dermis, the middle and thickest layer of human skin. “What’s actually losing volume is the layer below that – the fat layer – and there has never been any evidence that topical skincare products can reach that fat layer."

item.title: Mitsubishi Corp approves Arizona copper mining project, lifts investment
item.description: Japan's Mitsubishi Corp approved the construction of a copper mining project in Arizona, jointly with Canada's Hudbay Minerals , the company said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Japan's Mitsubishi Corp (8058.T) approved the construction of a copper mining project in Arizona, jointly with Canada's Hudbay Minerals (HBM.TO) , the company said on Wednesday. Here are details: Mitsubishi will make an additional equity contribution of $423 million toward the Copper World project's initial development, the company said It follows Mitsubishi's $420 million investment for a 30% stake and a $180 million contribution toward future development costs approved in August 2025 when the company acquired an interest in the project Mitsubishi's total investment in the project is expected to reach $1.02 billion The Copper World project was included in a [USN:L1N4080Q3 TEXT:"Japan-US critical minerals cooperation"] framework announced in March Production is expected to begin in the second half of 2029, with average annual copper output of about 100,000 tons over the life of the mine

item.title: Time to move on from LIV, says Oosthuizen
item.description: Former British Open champion Louis Oosthuizen is set to become the latest player to leave LIV Golf with the South African saying it was time to move on from the breakaway circuit as it grapples with an uncertain future.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former British Open champion Louis Oosthuizen is set to become the latest player to leave LIV Golf with the South African saying it was time to move on from the breakaway circuit as it grapples with an uncertain future. Former world number one Jon Rahm is among those quitting the rebel circuit, which is fighting to emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy after Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) said in April it was cutting funding. LIV has secured [USN:L4N45R1JI TEXT:"investment from BC Partners Credit"] and is set to make a decision this month on whether it winds down or moves forward with a 2.0 model. Oosthuizen, who was among the first golfers to join LIV and played in its inaugural event in June 2022, told the South China Morning Post that the proposed stripped-back schedule would require a lot of international travel for single events. "I need to arrange my own schedule and look after my body," said the 44-year-old ahead of this week's Hong Kong Open. "I want to play near one spot for three weeks at a time, not have all the big travelling for one tournament. "I loved LIV and the team aspect, but it's time to move on," added the 2010 British Open champion. Oosthuizen is still listed as captain of the Southern Guards GC team on the LIV website. Reuters has contacted LIV for confirmation on his departure. According to reports in U.S. media, players have a soft deadline of October 25 to make an official decision on whether they will stick with the circuit.

item.title: Smouldering debt risk haunts French markets
item.description: France isn't in a debt crisis yet. But it's running out of time, money and political space to avoid one.
item.dc:creator: Mike Dolan
item.content:encoded: France isn't in a [USN:L6N4660NP TEXT:"debt crisis"] yet. But it's running out of time, money and political space to avoid one. For impatient sovereign debt markets, a resolution to France's smouldering budget and political crises may still be months away, as the two reinforce each other. [USN:S8N42Q0F9 TEXT:"Weekend street riots"] and subsequent curfews are just the latest instalment in a slow-burn budget mess that's been building for at least a year, intensifying again last month. No clear picture is likely to emerge for at least another eight months. Most immediately, the direct cost of damage to business and confidence is substantial, although economists caution against equating repair costs with lost gross domestic product (GDP). That said, estimates derived from similar periods of unrest in France over the past 10 years suggest the initial hit to GDP could be 0.1 to 0.2 percentage points before being recouped. In the wider French fiscal and political story, however, that is significant when annual GDP is growing by only about 0.5%. Dutch bank ING warns France is entering a "difficult circle." "France has neither the fiscal room to buy social peace nor the political room to impose adjustment easily," ING economist Charlotte de Montpellier wrote on Tuesday. "Weak growth worsens the fiscal position, budgetary concerns push interest rates higher, and tighter financial conditions weigh further on activity." The absence of extraordinary, and at this point unlikely, European Central Bank action to stabilize the situation means market bargain hunters may pass for now. Extreme market moves during social or political unrest can build a risk premium, offering long-term investors extra compensation while they wait for normalization. But long-term buyers face strong headwinds. [USN:L4N45Y18M TEXT:"Short-term hedge funds"] hold a growing share of major bond markets, while France relies heavily on foreign capital, against the backdrop of a [USN:L1N4650EF TEXT:"drawn-out political crisis"] ahead of April's presidential election. LOOP THE LOOP The heart of the matter is that a divided French parliament can't pass the annual government budget plan needed to keep a lid on a ballooning budget deficit and debt pile. If it can't muster agreement, Goldman Sachs thinks the wrangling could run well into December, and the annual budget gap could hit 6.4% of GDP. Even if the government succeeds in getting its €54 billion ($60.7 billion) savings package through, the deficit will still be 5% of GDP or more for a third year running, sending debt above 120% of GDP for the first time — second only to Italy in the euro zone. Pension reforms that could have changed that picture were scrapped a year ago in the first budget standoff. The bond market reaction has been to catapult [USN:L6N4660NP TEXT:"French 10-year sovereign borrowing costs"] almost 1.4 percentage points higher since midyear and nearly doubled the 10-year spread over Germany to more than 150 basis points. The French 10-year discount to US Treasuries , meantime, has shrunk by 50 bps to less than 20 bps. That feeds back into budget calculations. Estimates now suggest these elevated borrowing rates may mean French annual debt-servicing costs alone could almost double from last year's 2.2% of GDP to 4% by 2030. That puts even greater pressure on the annual primary deficit, which excludes servicing costs, if the overall deficit is to hit the euro zone's 3% target by 2030. Further fiscal pressure on the already slow-growing economy would also inflate debt-to-GDP ratios. French stocks (.FCHI) have shuddered, losing 10% over two months, with leading bank stocks losing more than twice that. French credit default swaps now suggest a sovereign credit rating four notches below the single A it has now — placing it in BBB territory, just above junk status and below Italy's. So much for the budget wrangling. The politics is even more complicated and the street unrest merely adds another twist. Far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen appears to have the edge in [USN:L8N4601WM TEXT:"opinion polling"], but her likely runoff opponent come April will be far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon, who has advocated an effective default by [USN:L8N44L1BW TEXT:"cancelling French debt"] held by the Bank of France. Neither would thrill investors, given the political and policy tail risks involved. Whoever wins would then likely have to call snap parliamentary elections in June to seek a workable majority to tackle the budget. Natixis' election primer cautions that it may be too early to rely on opinion polls this far out, citing many instances over recent decades in which early polling proved wide of the mark, particularly in a two-round system. It may yet be premature to rule out leading centrist [USN:L6N45L0MB TEXT:"Edouard Philippe"], it says. Either way, what candidates say about controlling the budget may now be as important as the outcome of the election itself. But if you're looking for a magic solution to this saga, prepare for a long, nervy wait. (The opinions expressed here are those of Mike Dolan , a columnist for Reuters.) Enjoying this column? Check out Reuters Open Interest (ROI), your essential new source for global financial commentary. Follow ROI on LinkedIn, and X. And listen to the Morning Bid daily podcast on Apple , Spotify , or the Reuters app . Subscribe to hear Reuters journalists discuss the biggest news in markets and finance seven days a week. ($1 = 0.8902 euros)

item.title: UK approves long-delayed Jackdaw gas field
item.description: Britain on Wednesday approved the Jackdaw North Sea gas field, ending years of legal and political wrangling that had pitted the Labour government's climate commitments against its push to bolster energy security.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain on Wednesday approved the Jackdaw North Sea gas field, ending years of legal and political wrangling that had pitted the Labour government's climate commitments against its push to bolster energy security. Britain's energy minister, Miatta Fahnbulleh, said the project will start to supply gas to British homes and businesses from as early as the end of this month. At the same time, she said a new Energy Wealth Fund would be established by the government with a £2 billion downpayment to reinvest oil and gas revenues into the climate transition. Fahnbulleh said Jackdaw was expected to increase domestic gas production by around 6% at its peak and support the country's gas supply over its lifespan of up to 11 years, boosting energy security and protecting hundreds of jobs. "At a time when people are really struggling, it's right that we look in a responsible way at maximising the existing energy reserves we have in Britain that could help," said Prime Minister Andy Burnham. "Even on our ambitious climate path, we’ll still require oil and gas as part of our energy needs for decades to come. That’s why we’re taking a pragmatic approach to the North Sea." Adura, the joint venture between energy giants Shell (SHEL.L) and Norway's Equinor (EQNR.OL) that operates the project, has said Jackdaw will produce up to 40,000 barrels of oil equivalent of natural gas per day at peak output. The fate of Jackdaw had been in limbo for years. The previous Conservative government approved the project in 2022, but climate activists challenged the decision in court alongside approval for the Rosebank oil and gas field. A 2025 ruling barred operators from extracting oil or gas until they received fresh government consent that takes into account emissions from the burning of the fields' hydrocarbons. The decision has taken on added significance for Burnham since he took office in July. Britain's high energy costs for households and industry have weighed on the economy, while US President Donald Trump has repeatedly urged Burnham to expand drilling in the North Sea to help lower prices. At the same time, the issue has become a rallying point for climate activists, who say approving new fossil fuel projects undermines Labour's green pledges and ignores warnings from a summer of record-breaking heat across Europe.

item.title: Trump says companies should pay 'dividend' to communities to make data centers popular
item.description: US President Donald Trump said if companies want to make data centers popular, they should pay the community or individuals within the community a "dividend".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said if companies want to make data centers popular, they should pay the community or individuals within the community a "dividend". "I have watched the process closely, and data centers that were highly unpopular in a certain area, have become extremely popular when a financial deal is struck," Trump said in his Truth Social post on Wednesday. Data centers fueling the rise of AI have become a political [USN:L6N43G12P TEXT:"flashpoint"] in communities across the country, with opposition uniting voters across ideological lines.

item.title: South African rand flat before mid-year budget review
item.description: The South African rand was little changed in early trade on Wednesday as investors avoided taking large positions ahead of the mid-year budget review, which is expected to provide clues on the country's fiscal outlook and credit-rating prospects.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The South African rand was little changed in early trade on Wednesday as investors avoided taking large positions ahead of the mid-year budget review, which is expected to provide clues on the country's fiscal outlook and credit-rating prospects. At 0542 GMT, the rand traded at 16.4075 against the dollar , a whisker away from Tuesday's close Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana is due to deliver the Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement at around 1200 GMT Economists expect Godongwana to present an [USN:L6N4600J1 TEXT:"improved fiscal outlook"], with a revenue windfall bolstering a push to regain an investment-grade credit rating But record-high fuel prices, weak economic growth and pressure to spend ahead of November 4 local government elections could limit how much of the windfall the Treasury saves Statistics South Africa is set to release consumer inflation (ZACPIY=ECI) and retail sales (ZARET=ECI) data on Wednesday, providing a snapshot of price pressures and consumer demand in Africa's largest economy as the Middle East conflict keeps fuel costs elevated Economists polled by Reuters expect headline inflation to accelerate to 4.7% in September from 4.4% in August, while annual retail sales growth is forecast to edge up to 3.5% in August from 3.4% in July Investec forecasts inflation at 4.6%, while Nedbank expects a reading of 4.8%, citing higher transport costs driven by rising fuel prices and rand weakness The rand fell more than 2% against the dollar in September South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond was flat in early deals, with the yield at 8.735%

item.title: Rubio says Witkoff-Zelenskiy meeting 'positive', ideas to be discussed with Russia
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Wednesday that US special envoy Steve Witkoff's meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy was positive and that Witkoff would share the results with Russia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Wednesday that US special envoy Steve Witkoff's meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy was positive and that Witkoff would share the results with Russia. Rubio also reiterated that Washington had not pulled back Kyiv's ability to access SpaceX's (SPCX.O) Starlink, a satellite system vital to Ukraine's war effort, contradicting reports that the US [USN:L1N4610ZC TEXT:"government had a role"] in slowing the service for the Ukrainian military. Zelenskiy traveled [USN:L1N466099 TEXT:"to Oslo to meet Witkoff"] on Tuesday, as Ukraine seeks to repair ties with the US amid tensions over US military support, intelligence sharing and Ukraine's access to the military version of Starlink. Witkoff will meet Russian President Vladimir Putin on Wednesday. Rubio told reporters in Mumbai during a [USN:L6N4660JU TEXT:"visit to India"] that nothing surprising came out of Witkoff's talks with the Ukrainian leader. "He will now, armed with those ideas, be able to go to St. Petersburg and share them with the Russian side, and let's see if we can make some progress," he said. On Starlink, he said: "What I can tell you with certainty is the president of the United States, nor anyone in our system, ever requested that any changes to that system be made." "We cannot direct a private company as to the decisions they make or do not make," he added. "I'm not aware that we knew about this decision beforehand ... but it's irrelevant. The bottom line is that it is governed by a private commercial contract as to the how their stuff can be used ... And so we'll continue to engage on the matter." Elon Musk, the CEO of SpaceX, last week said that because the systems were owned and controlled by the US government, any limits on speed or usage were decided by the US military or the US president. The US under President Donald Trump has largely stopped providing weapons directly to Ukraine but lets European countries buy US weaponry on Kyiv's behalf under a program known as Prioritised Ukraine Requirements List (PURL). It has also provided intelligence and technology that Europe cannot match.

item.title: 温暖化加速で生態系が転換点接近、自然保護に投資を＝独研究所長
item.description:
Simon Jessop
[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Simon Jessop

[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - ポツダム気候影響研究所（ＰＩＫ）のヨハン・ロックストローム所長は２０日、化石燃料の使用に伴う排出によって地球温暖化が加速し、地球上の極めて重要な生態系の多くが不可逆的な転換点に近づいていると述べた。

同氏は、ロイターの会議「サステナビリティー・ヨーロッパ」で講演し、サンゴ礁やアマゾン熱帯雨林の損傷が回復不能な状態に近づいていると指摘。カリブ海から暖かい海水を運んで西欧の気候を温暖に保つ海流など、大西洋の海洋循環システムの一部も崩壊に近づいていると述べた。

最新の科学的知見では今後数年以内に世界の平均地表温度の上昇幅が摂氏１．５度を超えるとの見通しが確認されており、極端な気象現象の頻度と強度が増すと分析した。

同氏は１１月９日に開幕する国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）を前に、備えを進め、レジリエンス（強靱性）を事業に組み込もうとしている企業は、気候と自然を別個の問題としてでなく一体の課題として扱うべきだと指摘。脱炭素化の取り組みを優先しつつ、自然保護につながる投資も行うべきとし、特に生物多様性や淡水資源の維持・回復に関わる事業を挙げた。

さらに、内燃機関車の段階的廃止に関する規制の緩和を求めるロビー活動は「極めて憂慮すべきだ」と述べ、ガソリンや軽油関連の補助金が消費者の電気自動車（ＥＶ）需要を阻害していると指摘した。

item.title: Anthropic registra pérdidas netas de más de 80.000 millones de dólares en el primer semestre
item.description: Las pérdidas netas de Anthropic se dispararon hasta alcanzar los 80.700 millones de dólares en el primer semestre de este año, en gran parte debido al aumento del valor razonable de los bonos convertibles en acciones de esta empresa emergente de inteligencia artificial, según un borrador del folleto informativo de una oferta pública inicial prevista al que ha tenido acceso Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Echo Wang
item.content:encoded: Las pérdidas netas de Anthropic se dispararon hasta alcanzar los 80.700 millones de dólares en el primer semestre de este año, en gran parte debido al aumento del valor razonable de los bonos convertibles en acciones de esta empresa emergente de inteligencia artificial, según un borrador del folleto informativo de una oferta pública inicial prevista al que ha tenido acceso Reuters. Se espera que la empresa, con sede en San Francisco, salga a bolsa en noviembre y algunos inversionistas están barajando ahora una valoración más baja, de alrededor de 1,5 billones de dólares, tras sus últimas publicaciones financieras, informó Reuters la semana pasada. Su pérdida del primer semestre, que se amplió desde los 13.000 millones de dólares registrados un año antes, incluía un cargo contable de 72.000 millones de dólares que reflejaba un aumento en el valor estimado de los bonos que podrían convertirse eventualmente en acciones de Anthropic, más que en costos en efectivo vinculados a sus operaciones, según el documento. Estas revelaciones ponen de relieve los elevados costos de la carrera por la IA, al tiempo que los inversionistas analizan con mayor detenimiento si las enormes sumas que se están invirtiendo en chips y centros de datos generarán una rentabilidad suficiente. Anthropic se ha comprometido a invertir al menos 518.000 millones de dólares a lo largo de una década en servicios en la nube, informática e infraestructura. La empresa gastó casi 9.000 millones de dólares en capacidad informática e infraestructura durante el primer semestre, frente a los 2.300 millones del año anterior, según el documento S-1. Anthropic no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters. COSTOS DE FINANCIACIÓN En una reunión con inversionistas celebrada el 14 de octubre, Anthropic dijo a posibles participantes en su oferta pública inicial que sus ingresos del tercer trimestre aumentaron un 45% respecto al trimestre anterior, hasta los 16.800 millones de dólares, informó Reuters, citando a personas familiarizadas con el asunto. Si bien las cifras aliviaron algunas preocupaciones sobre los enormes costos de desarrollar sistemas de inteligencia artificial, la desaceleración del crecimiento intertrimestral decepcionó a algunos inversionistas. Los ingresos del segundo trimestre habían superado en más del doble los del primero, hasta alcanzar los 11.600 millones de dólares. Una acogida más fría de la OPI de Anthropic podría lastrar al conjunto del mercado de la IA, cuyas perspectivas a corto plazo dependen en gran medida del éxito de la colocación, según los inversionistas, antes de la posible salida a bolsa de su competidora OpenAI el próximo año. Reuters informó en septiembre de que Anthropic registró una pérdida neta de 42.000 millones de dólares en 2025, atribuible en su mayor parte a un cargo contable similar. A medida que aumentaba la valoración de Anthropic, el valor razonable estimado de esos títulos de deuda se triplicó respecto al año anterior. Excluido ese cargo, Anthropic registró una pérdida operativa de unos 8.100 millones de dólares y unos ingresos de 4.600 millones de dólares en 2025. La empresa se ha beneficiado de la popularidad de Claude Code, su asistente de programación, que los desarrolladores utilizan para escribir software y crear aplicaciones.

item.title: 米、軽油不足で国内外に増産要請 中間選挙前に価格高騰
item.description:
Nathan Crooks Arathy Somasekhar
[タイタスビル（米ペンシルベニア州）／ヒューストン ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nathan Crooks　Arathy Somasekhar

[タイタスビル（米ペンシルベニア州）／ヒューストン ２０日 ロイター] - 米エネルギー省の高官２人は２０日、燃料増産に向けて国内外の石油精製業者と協力していると明らかにした。軽油不足で価格が上昇し、１１月の中間選挙を前に有権者の政権への不満が高まっている。

軽油価格は、中東紛争による供給混乱とウクライナによるロシアの製油所攻撃を受け、過去最高に急騰している。

トランプ政権は、２月２８日の対イラン戦闘開始以来上昇している燃料価格の引き下げに向け、複数の措置を講じてきた。ロシア産軽油の輸出制限緩和や、増産に向けた国防生産法の発動に加え、通常は公道を走行しない機械などに用途が限られる赤色軽油の商用車での使用を認めた。

軽油は、貿易や経済活動を支える運輸、農業、重工業の多くで動力源として使われ、世界経済に不可欠だ。

ライト米エネルギー長官はヒューストンで「稼働できる製油所は全て再稼働させる方向で話し合っている」と述べた。「協議は行われているが、難しい課題だ。全てが実現すると言っているわけではない」とした。

＜米国内の増産は困難＞

アナリストによると、米国の製油所はほぼフル稼働している上、近年は複数の施設が閉鎖されており、国内生産を迅速に増やす余地は乏しい。

製油所の拡張には多額の資金が必要で、増設設備の複雑さによっては、完成まで数カ月から数年かかる。

ライト氏は、インドでの石油精製量を増やし、石油製品を世界市場に供給するため、同国とも協力していると述べた。

米石油協会（ＡＰＩ）のマイク・ソマーズ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、ペンシルベニア州タイタスビルで開かれたエネルギーフォーラムの合間にロイターに対し、米国の製油所の稼働率は９５─１００％に達していると説明。価格高騰を受け、定期保守を先送りしていると述べた。

ソマーズ氏は、政権が検討している国防生産法を活用した休止施設の再稼働には、多額の資金が必要だと述べた。

バンス米副大統領は先週、デレクＵＳホールディングスがテキサス州に保有する製油所の能力拡張に国防生産法を活用すると述べた。

トランプ氏は２０２５年、国家安全保障上重要とされるエネルギー関連事業に対し、国防生産法に基づく１０億ドルの資金を盛り込んだ法案に署名し、成立させた。

ライト氏は、石油精製と国防生産法について「さらに取り組むべきことがある」と述べたが、詳細は示さなかった。

ソマーズ氏は中国の余剰精製能力に注目し、中国政府が現在、軽油輸出を禁止していると指摘。「長期的に価格を引き下げるには、中国政府がまさに鍵を握る」と述べた。

在ワシントン中国大使館の報道官は、問題解決の鍵はイランでの停戦実現だと説明。「中国は、世界のエネルギー安全保障を共同で守り、産業網と供給網の安定を維持するため、全ての関係者との意思疎通を続ける用意がある」と述べた。

＜欧州に軽油放出を要請＞

トランプ氏は今月、価格引き下げに向け、ロシア産軽油に対する制裁を一時的に免除した。ライト氏は、ロシア産軽油が米国に輸入される場合、ニューイングランド地方に向かう可能性が高いと述べた。

トランプ政権はまた、世界市場の需給を均衡させるため、欧州に燃料放出の拡大を働きかけている。

ハウストベイト米エネルギー次官は、タイタスビルで開かれたエネルギーフォーラムで「友好国と協力し、製油所の処理量を増やすための新たな革新的手法を探っている」と述べた。

トランプ政権は欧州に軽油５０００万バレルの放出を求めてきたが、先進国が合意した放出量はその目標に届かなかった。パリに本部を置く国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）は先週、３月に約束した原油と石油製品の放出を加速させると発表。これには、２０００万バレル超の軽油を可能な限り速やかに放出することが含まれる。

先進国による緊急石油備蓄の放出を調整するＩＥＡのビロル事務局長は２０日、必要に応じて加盟国による追加放出を調整する用意があると述べた。

item.title: Australia's CSL appoints Deborah Waterhouse as CEO
item.description: Australia's CSL said on Wednesday it had appointed Deborah Waterhouse as the company's chief executive officer and managing director from February 1, 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia's CSL (CSL.AX) said on Wednesday it had appointed Deborah Waterhouse as the company's chief executive officer and managing director from February 1, 2027. Waterhouse, who is currently the CEO of ViiV Healthcare, a JV majority-owned by GSK (GSK.L) , also serves as the president of GSK Global Health. She has more than 25 years of experience managing global specialty pharmaceutical firms across the US, UK, continental Europe and Australia, CSL said in an exchange filing. It added that current interim CEO and managing director Gordon Naylor will continue in his positions until February next year, following which he will resume his role on the biotech company's board as a non-executive director.

item.title: NBA roundup: Sixers spoil Knicks' title celebration in season opener
item.description: Tyrese Maxey scored a game-high 28 points Tuesday night for the visiting Philadelphia 76ers, who spoiled the New York Knicks' ring and banner-raising ceremony with a 106-100 victory in the season opener for both teams.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tyrese Maxey scored a game-high 28 points Tuesday night for the visiting Philadelphia 76ers, who spoiled the New York Knicks' ring and banner-raising ceremony with a 106-100 victory in the season opener for both teams. Prior to the game, the Knicks received their championship rings from Walt "Clyde" Frazier -- a member of the franchise's previous title-winning teams in 1970 and 1973 and an analyst on New York's television broadcast team -- and raised the banner commemorating the long-awaited crown. However, the 76ers, who were swept by the Knicks in the Eastern Conference semifinals before adding Jaylen Brown and LeBron James over the summer, dampened the festivities by taking the lead for good with an 11-0 run to end the third quarter. Brown (19 points, eight rebounds, six assists) and James (14 points, nine rebounds, seven assists) produced strong debuts for the 76ers, who haven't won the title since 1983. Karl-Anthony Towns (19 points, 12 rebounds) and Andre Drummond (12 points, 14 rebounds) recorded double-doubles for the Knicks. Brunson finished with 21 points but shot just 6-of-19 from the field. Josh Hart had 14 points while OG Anunoby added 10 points. Pistons 121, Celtics 113 Duncan Robinson scored 15 of his 21 points in the fourth quarter as Detroit reeled off 23 unanswered points and downed visiting Boston in the first game of the NBA regular season. Jalen Duren and Cade Cunningham scored 22 points apiece for the Pistons, who had an Eastern Conference-best 60 wins last season. Javonte Green came off the bench to score 19 points in 18 minutes, spurring Detroit's run which turned a 10-point deficit into a 112-99 lead with 3:33 left. Paul George, making his Celtics debut, had a game-high 38 points. Payton Pritchard and Derrick White scored 17 points apiece, but Jayson Tatum was held to 13 points on 6-for-23 shooting and contributed a game-high 11 assists. Thunder 116, Spurs 104 Shai Gilgeous-Alexander poured in 32 points as visiting Oklahoma City built a huge first-half lead and held on for a victory over San Antonio in the season opener between last year's top two teams in the Western Conference. Jared McCain added 20 points and matched his career high with six 3-pointers for the Thunder. Chet Holmgren had 14 points and Jalen Williams finished with 12. Stephon Castle led San Antonio with 24 points while Dylan Harper added 18, De'Aaron Fox hit for 14, Victor Wembanyama had 12 points, 13 rebounds and six blocked shots, and Keldon Johnson tallied 10 points. Wembanyama went 1 of 13 from the field, with his only basket on a dunk on a lob to end the third quarter. --Field Level Media

China says APEC finance ministers agree to boost policy coordination

FAST

HONG KONG: Finance ministers from member economies in the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum have agreed to strengthen macroeconomic policy communication and coordination to address external risks and challenges, Chinese Minister of Finance Lan Foan said on Wednesday (Oct 21). At the conclusion of the ministers' meeting in Hong Kong, they also reached a consensus on promoting practical cooperation in the financial sector, which focused on supporting people's livelihoods, digital infrastructure financing and locally adapted measures for inclusive finance development, Lan said at a briefing. Separately, a policy statement was released on digital infrastructure financing for the Asia-Pacific region, aimed at supporting regional trade, economic connectivity and enhancing economic opportunities. "We encourage member economies to develop reliable, accessible, scalable, trusted, secure and resilient digital infrastructure; enhance digital literacy and skills; promote interoperability; and cross-border digital connectivity to accelerate the digital transformation in the Asia-Pacific region," it said. Ministers also sought deeper collaboration between the public sector, the private sector and multilateral development banks to foster innovation and risk mitigation, it said.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
フランス各地で発生した騒乱は、燃料価格の高騰など生活費上昇への市民の怒りを浮き彫りにした。いま欧州各国では、こうした生活費高騰を背景に社会不安が広がっている。中でも来年に選挙を控えるフランスやドイツ、イタリアなどでは、現状に対する市民の不満が極右政党の勢いを後押ししている。

＜抗議デモの原因は何か＞

今年2月に始まったイラン戦争は、エネルギー輸送に不可欠な海上ルートを寸断し、世界各国のエネルギー市場に大きな混乱をもたらした。これが各国政府、消費者、企業の頭痛の種となっている。例えば欧州委員会の試算では、ガス価格は140％高騰し、ディーゼル価格は2倍になった。欧州にかかる追加負担はおよそ1000億ユーロ（約18兆円）に上るとされる。

＜フランス＞

フランスの抗議活動は当初、学校の問題が中心だった。パリ北部の郊外にある一部の学校で、施設が老朽化していたことを訴えていた。しかし、その後、抗議活動の様相は変わった。抗議デモは生活費高騰や公共サービスといった問題にも広がっている。その変化は街頭でもはっきりと見られる。抗議に参加した人々は、例えば燃料価格に怒りを感じていると私たちに語った。

今の生活費は本当に恐ろしいほどだ。とても暮らしを維持できない水準にまで物価が上がっている。

これまでに数千の店舗が略奪に遭ったり、何らかの被害を受けたりしている。

リモージュでは、市庁舎が放火された。

2027年のフランス大統領選で有力候補とされる2人も、燃料価格の上昇を取り上げている。極右指導者のマリーヌ・ルペン氏は、エネルギー価格の高騰を選挙戦の主要な争点の1つにしている。これは彼女の支持層にも強く訴えるものだ。例えば地方で車を使う人々にとっては、非常に関心の高い問題だ。

イラン戦争開始以降、ルペン氏の支持率は逆に上昇し、現職のマクロン大統領の支持率は低下している。

＜ドイツ＞

ドイツのメルツ首相は2025年に選出されたばかりだが、その後、数多くの問題に直面し、自身と所属政党の支持率が急落している。

その一因がインフレと燃料価格の高騰だ。9月のインフレ率は約3年ぶりの高水準に迫り、ディーゼル価格は過去最高に達した。極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（AfD）」は、この状況を追い風にしている。

AfDはエネルギー価格の高騰を材料にメルツ氏を批判している。またウクライナを巡っては、欧州の主流派の考え方とは相いれない解決策を掲げている。AfDはロシアとのエネルギー関係の修復を望んでおり、ロシアの豊富なエネルギー資源へのアクセスはドイツ企業の利益になり、ウクライナ支援はいたずらに自国を苦しめる行為だと主張している。

＜イタリア＞

週末にはミラノなど北部の都市で抗議活動が起きた。一方、南部では、もっと前から抗議活動が続いている。例えばシチリア島の農家に話を聞いたところ、今はエネルギー価格があまりに高いため、種をまいても採算が取れないと語っていた。

真っ先に我々を苦しめたのは燃料価格だった。真っ先に、それが原因で作業を止めざるを得なくなったのだ。本来なら今頃は、畑や農場で種まきの準備を終えているはずだ。

メローニ首相は今、新たな極右政党との競争に直面している。この党は今年結成されたばかりだが、すでにイタリアで4番目に大きな政党となっている。

党首は元陸軍将軍のロベルト・バンナッチ氏で、同氏もロシアとのエネルギー関係の修復を主張している。

このほか、ポルトガル、スペイン、ベルギー、アルバニアでも大勢の人々が抗議活動に参加し、声を上げている。

政権を狙う勢力は、その声に耳を傾けている。経済への不安が、欧州各地の政治をますます左右するようになっている。

item.title: Nikita Kucherov's points milestone helps Lightning thrash Knights
item.description: Nikita Kucherov scored a goal and had two assists to move into a tie for the Tampa Bay career scoring lead and as the Lightning cruised to a 6-2 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Tuesday in Las Vegas.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Nikita Kucherov scored a goal and had two assists to move into a tie for the Tampa Bay career scoring lead and as the Lightning cruised to a 6-2 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Tuesday in Las Vegas. Kucherov capped the scoring with a breakaway goal early in the third period for his 1,137th career point, tying the team career mark set by Steven Stamkos. Anthony Cirelli scored twice during the Lightning's three-goal second period. John Carlson, Brandon Hagel and Victor Hedman added a goal apiece while Andrei Vasilevskiy stopped 32 shots for Tampa Bay, which won its third straight game. Mark Stone and Ivan Barbashev tallied for Vegas, which had a three-game winning streak snapped. Carter Hart finished with 15 saves. Tampa Bay, playing the first game of a three-game road trip that also includes stops at Colorado and Utah, took a 1-0 lead at the 4:11 mark of the first period. On a power play, Hagel deflected a point shot by Charle-Edouard D'Astous past Hart for his team-best seventh goal. Vegas tied it when Barbashev put the rebound of a Mitch Marner shot into an open net for his first goal at 13:16 of the first. The Lightning regained the lead 48 seconds later when Carlson buried a rebound of his own shot. The Golden Knights tied it near the end of the period on a short-handed goal by Stone, who ripped in a wrist shot from the bottom left circle after a turnover by Vasilevskiy for his team-leading eighth goal. Tampa Bay took control of the game with three unanswered goals in the second period to build a 5-2 lead. Cirelli scored twice in a 3:25 span, the first on a one-timer inside the right post off a Kucherov pass from the end boards, the second a wrist shot from the edge of the left circle for his 150th career goal. Hedman made it 5-2 at 17:56 of the middle frame with a shot from the left point past a Jake Guentzel screen. Early in the third period, Kucherov stole the puck from defenseman Jeremy Lauzon near the blue line and skated in and roofed a shot past Hart's blocker side at 5:16. --Field Level Media

item.title: Australian miner Fortescue fires senior executive after sexual harassment probe
item.description: Fortescue , Australia's third-largest miner, said on Wednesday it fired a senior executive following an investigation into allegations of sexual harassment and bullying.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Fortescue (FMG.AX) , Australia's third-largest miner, said on Wednesday it fired a senior executive following an investigation into allegations of sexual harassment and bullying. [USN:L8N44G266 TEXT:"The investigation"], conducted by law firm MinterEllison, found conduct that breached company policies and values, a Fortescue spokesperson said in a statement. Fortescue did not name the executive or provide additional details of the findings. Sexual harassment has been a persistent issue at mine sites in Western Australia and sparked an enquiry in the state in 2021. "Sexual harassment, bullying and other behaviour that makes people feel unsafe has no place at Fortescue," the statement said. "The investigation found conduct that breached Fortescue's policies, as well as our values. The board sub-committee overseeing the matter therefore ceased the individual's contract." The probe into the allegations of sexual harassment and bullying by the executive was made public in August by the Australian Financial Review newspaper. Fortescue [USN:L8N44M03J TEXT:"suspended"] the person later that month, after initially saying legal advice indicated it was not necessary. Fortescue was also served with a [USN:L1N42X01V TEXT:"class action suit"] in July alleging workplace misconduct, including sexual harassment and sex-based discrimination.

item.title: DNB beats forecasts despite pressure from lending competition
item.description: Norway's largest bank DNB reported better-than-expected third-quarter earnings on Wednesday, despite continued pressure on margins from intense competition across lending markets.
item.dc:creator: Jagoda Darlak, Agnieszka Gosciak
item.content:encoded: Norway's largest bank DNB (DNB.OL) reported better-than-expected third-quarter earnings on Wednesday, despite continued pressure on margins from intense competition across lending markets. Its net profit fell 7.9% to 9.84 billion Norwegian crowns ($1.05 billion) in the July-to-September period, from 10.68 billion a year earlier. Analysts had expected 9.06 billion crowns on average, a poll compiled by the bank showed. DNB has weathered a period of margin pressure driven by fierce competition across lending markets, even as Norway's central bank has returned to raising interest rates in response to persistent inflation. "We are seeing a strong development in savings and investments, with both more customers and increased saving," DNB's CEO Kjerstin Braathen said in a statement. DNB said it delivered profitable lending growth across its businesses, while average lending spreads widened by 3 basis points quarter-on-quarter to 1.33%. Net interest income, a key measure of lending profitability, fell to 15.50 billion Norwegian crowns in the quarter from 15.99 billion a year earlier, slightly below the 15.59 billion expected by analysts. However, it rose 2.5% from the previous quarter due to repricing effects and higher interest on equity, as well as one additional interest day, the bank said. Norway's central bank last month [USN:L8N45G0I1 TEXT:"raised"] its policy interest rate by 25 basis points to 4.50% and said it may hike again to contain inflation. The new rates will apply from November 29 for existing mortgages and deposits, it said. Norway's annual core inflation rate [USN:L8N45V08O TEXT:"remained"] at 3.0% year-on-year in September, Statistics Norway (SSB) data showed earlier in October, supporting expectations that interest rates will stay elevated. ($1 = 9.3951 Norwegian crowns)

item.title: León gana de visita a Tigres UANL en torneo mexicano con goles del panameño Díaz De León y del colombiano Cambindo
item.description: León sacó el martes un triunfo de su visita a Tigres UANL por 2-0 gracias a los goles del panameño Ismael Díaz de León y del colombiano Diber Cambindo en la decimotercera jornada del torneo Apertura del fútbol mexicano.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: León sacó el martes un triunfo de su visita a Tigres UANL por 2-0 gracias a los goles del panameño Ismael Díaz de León y del colombiano Diber Cambindo en la decimotercera jornada del torneo Apertura del fútbol mexicano. Con su sexto triunfo, León llegó a 21 puntos para subir del séptimo al cuarto lugar y mantenerse en la zona que da acceso a la postemporada o liguilla. Los primeros ocho lugares de la tabla general al final de las 17 jornadas de la fase regular obtienen ese boleto. El club de la Universidad Autónoma de Nuevo León dominó la mayor parte del partido disputado en el estadio Universitario, pero el equipo visitante marcó el primer gol a los 19 minutos cuando Díaz de León aprovechó un error del defensa Rafael Guerrero, quien retrasó el balón débilmente, lo que aprovechó el delantero centroamericano para robarlo y definir con un suave remate ante la salida del portero argentino Nahuel Guzmán. Tigres continuó dominando el encuentro, pero no fue capaz de concretar las opciones que generó gracias a las atinadas intervenciones del portero Óscar García y de la zona defensiva de León. Cerca del final, Cambindo anotó el segundo gol en una jugada de contragolpe que definió de derecha ante la salida de Guzmán a los 89 minutos. "Feliz y contento por sacar los tres puntos que nos colocan arriba de la tabla. Desde el inicio del torneo pensamos en llegar a lo más alto que es ser campeones, esa es la mentalidad de todos", dijo el portero de León, Óscar García, a la cadena Fox. En los otros partidos disputados el martes, Guadalajara ganó 1-0 a Necaxa gracias al autogol del defensa uruguayo Agustín Oliveros, quien metió el balón a su propia portería al desviar un centro enviado por Roberto Alvarado desde el sector derecho a los 77 minutos. Las "Chivas" de Guadalajara llegaron a 23 puntos, uno menos de los que registra el líder América. Por su parte, Atlante venció 1-0 de visita a Bravos de Ciudad Juárez con gol de Nicolás Carrera. En tanto, Atlético de San Luis derrotó 2-1 a Querétaro con tantos del chileno Felipe Mora y del zaguero Daniel Parra en su propia portería. Para los "Gallos Blancos" de Querétaro anotó Ali Ávila. El miércoles, Puebla jugará en casa ante Monterrey, América visitará al Atlas, Toluca recibirá a Tijuana, el campeón Cruz Azul irá a Pachuca y Santos Laguna enfrentará a Pumas UNAM.

item.title: 原油運賃高騰、ブレント価格予測に上振れリスク＝ゴールドマン
item.description:
[２１日 ロイター] - ゴールドマン・サックスは２０日付のリポートで、世界の原油輸送運賃の平均が１年前の７倍の水準にとどまっており、中東紛争が続く間は急低下する可能性が低いとの見方を示した。同行の北海ブレント価格予測に一定の上振れリスクをもたらしているという。
リポートの主な内容は以下の通り。
• 世界の原油輸送運賃の平均は、１年前の１バレル＝３ドルから２０ドル超に急騰。中東航路では３５ドルを超えた。
• ホルムズ海峡を通航する際の戦争リスクに伴う割増料金と船舶間の積み替えが、世界の原油輸送運賃の前年比上昇幅の半分以上を占めている。
• 運賃上昇は貿易の流れを変えることで原油の油種間の価格差を拡大させ、石油製品価格を下支えする一方、精製業者の純利益率を圧迫している。
• 湾岸地域からの原油輸出が回復すれば原油価格の下落も予想されるが、船舶間の積み替えが輸出増加をけん引している場合は運賃が上昇する可能性がある。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２１日 ロイター] - ゴールドマン・サックスは２０日付のリポートで、世界の原油輸送運賃の平均が１年前の７倍の水準にとどまっており、中東紛争が続く間は急低下する可能性が低いとの見方を示した。同行の北海ブレント価格予測に一定の上振れリスクをもたらしているという。

リポートの主な内容は以下の通り。

• 世界の原油輸送運賃の平均は、１年前の１バレル＝３ドルから２０ドル超に急騰。中東航路では３５ドルを超えた。

• ホルムズ海峡を通航する際の戦争リスクに伴う割増料金と船舶間の積み替えが、世界の原油輸送運賃の前年比上昇幅の半分以上を占めている。

• 運賃上昇は貿易の流れを変えることで原油の油種間の価格差を拡大させ、石油製品価格を下支えする一方、精製業者の純利益率を圧迫している。

• 湾岸地域からの原油輸出が回復すれば原油価格の下落も予想されるが、船舶間の積み替えが輸出増加をけん引している場合は運賃が上昇する可能性がある。

• 基本シナリオは、北海ブレント価格が２０２６年末までに９０ドルに下落し、２７年平均で８０ドルになるというもの。ただ、このシナリオでも、ホルムズ海峡の安定した通航が確保されない限り、湾岸地域の生産回復と安定的な輸出には引き続き船舶間の積み替えが必要になる。

• 運賃の高止まり長期化に加え、船舶への攻撃激化や石油インフラの損傷、地政学リスクプレミアムが下がりにくくなる可能性が、北海ブレント価格予測の上振れリスクになる。

• 中東からの石油製品輸出の回復が進んでおらず、船舶燃料の供給逼迫が長期化する可能性がある。

item.title: Vaar Energi raises dividend as profit doubles on high oil, gas prices
item.description: Norway's Vaar Energi raised its cash dividend for a second consecutive quarter on Wednesday and reported a doubling of its third-quarter operating profit from a year earlier, supported by higher oil and gas prices.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Norway's Vaar Energi (VAR.OL) raised its cash dividend for a second consecutive quarter on Wednesday and reported a doubling of its third-quarter operating profit from a year earlier, supported by higher oil and gas prices. The company reported its July-September earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) at $2.21 billion, up from $1.1 billion a year ago, slightly bellow the average $2.26 billion forecast in a company-compiled poll of 10 analysts "We are pleased to report strong financial results in the third quarter of 2026, which is supported by high realised oil and gas prices," Vaar's CEO Nick Walker said in a statement Vaar said it would pay $400 million in dividend in both the third and fourth quarters of 2026 with an "extraordinary component", up from $350 million for the second quarter and $300 million for the first quarter of 2026 Vaar maintained its long-term production guidance at 450,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day (boed) and maintained 2026 development capital spending guidance at $2.5 billion-$2.7 billion Vaar [USN:TUCBXDLM9 TEXT:"said"] on October 12 it expected full-year 2026 production to be at 390,000 boepd, at the low end of its previous guidance of 390,000-410,000 boepd due to operational issues at several fields "We consider the Q3 results largely neutral with the level of the extraordinary dividend probably somewhat underwhelming, if anything. Shares should trade in line with peers today," analysts at broker DNB Carnegie said in a note

item.title: トランプ氏「驚くような結果に」、ノースカロライナで遊説 中間選挙迫る
item.description: ［グリーンビル（米ノースカロライナ州） ２０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［グリーンビル（米ノースカロライナ州）　２０日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は２０日、南部ノースカロライナ州の支持者集会で、自らが推す上院議員候補への投票を呼びかけた。支持率が過去最低に落ち込む中、政治的な逆風の克服を目指す。

トランプ氏は１１月３日の中間選挙を前に集中的な遊説を展開。共和党候補を支援するため、９月下旬以降の移動距離は２万９０００マイル（４万６６７１キロ）を超えた。ノースカロライナ州への訪問は２カ月連続で、同州での選挙結果の重要性を示している。

世論調査では、民主党のロイ・クーパー前州知事が共和党のマイケル・ワトリー氏を大きくリードしている。

両氏が争うのは、引退する共和党のトム・ティリス上院議員の議席。ティリス氏はかつてトランプ氏の盟友だったが、トランプ氏の看板政策である税制法案や国防政策を巡って袂（たもと）を分かった。ティリス氏は政治専門サイト「ポリティコ」に、共和党は中間選挙で「大惨事」に向かっており、「大敗する 」と断じた。

一方、トランプ氏は州東部グリーンビルでの演説で、ワトリー氏が懐疑的な見方を覆すと予想。「驚くような結果になる」とし「世論調査はわれわれの実態を正しく捉えたことがない。われわれの方が熱意がある」と訴えた。

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
Der Dax (.GDAXI) wird am Mittwoch der Kursentwicklung an den Terminmärkten zufolge fester in den Handel starten. Am Dienstag hatte der deutsche Leitindex 0,1 Prozent niedriger bei 25.304 Punkten [USN:L8N4660OF TEXT:"geschlossen"]. Sorgen über die weitere Entwicklung im Technologiesektor ließen die Anleger nicht los. [USN:L8N4662D9 TEXT:"Nach unten"] ging es auch an der Wall Street (.DJI) (.SPX) (.IXIC) . Im Mittelpunkt am Mittwoch steht erneut der Technologiesektor. Die Anleger blicken auf die Zahlen von SAP (SAPG.DE) , IBM (IBM.N) , Tesla (TSLA.O) und Meta (META.O) . Die schwedische Beteiligungsgesellschaft EQT (EQTAB.ST) will einem Bericht der Nachrichtenagentur Bloomberg zufolge den deutsch-niederländischen Diagnostik-Spezialisten Qiagen (QIA.DE) für mehr als neun Milliarden Euro übernehmen. Die Deutsche Börse (DB1Gn.DE) erwartet nun für 2026 Nettoerlöse von mehr als 6,5 Milliarden statt der zuvor angepeilten mehr als 6,4 Milliarden Euro. Der Sportartikelkonzern Adidas (ADSGn.DE) schraubt seine Gewinnprognose für das laufende Jahr nach einem Rekordquartal nach oben. Auf der Konjunkturseite veröffentlicht die Bundesbank ihren Monatsbericht. Darin wird unter anderem die wirtschaftliche Lage beleuchtet. Schlusskurse europäischer Aktien-Indizes und

item.title: 欧州航空運賃、来年「史上最大の値上げ」も＝ライアンエアＣＥＯ
item.description:
Philip Blenkinsop
[ブリュッセル ２０日 ロイター] - 欧州格安航空大手ライアンエアのマイケル・オ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州航空運賃、来年「史上最大の値上げ」も＝ライアンエアＣＥＯ 14:27 配信

写真は欧州格安航空大手ライアンエアのマイケル・オレアリー最高経営責任者。2025年9月、オーストリアのウィーンで撮影。 REUTERS/Lisa Leutner

Philip Blenkinsop

[ブリュッセル ２０日 ロイター] - 欧州格安航空大手ライアンエアのマイケル・オレアリー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２０日、欧州の航空運賃が来年、「史上最大の値上げ」を迎えるとの見方を示した。航空各社がジェット燃料価格の高騰に対するヘッジをほぼ実施していないことが背景にある。

オレアリー氏はブリュッセルでの記者会見で、航空会社の倒産や買収の結果、来年の座席数が減るとみている。これにヘッジ対策が講じられていない状況が加わり、運賃は最大２０％上昇するとの見通しを示した。

中東紛争により燃料価格が急騰し、ヘッジしていなかった航空会社の利益率が圧迫されている。

オレアリー氏は、ライアンエアやその他の欧州航空会社が２０２６年のジェット燃料について強力なヘッジポジションを保有しているとし、同社は２７年３月までの期間について１バレル当たり６７ドルで８０％をヘッジしていたと明らかにした。

同氏は２７年４月以降の期間については、大半の欧州航空会社がヘッジをしていないと言及。ライアンエアは来年の燃料費のわずか１５％を１バレル当たり８５ドルでヘッジしているが、スポット価格はその約２倍の水準にあるという。

一方、ベルギー政府が旅客１人当たりの航空税を現在の２ユーロから来年１月に７ユーロへ引き上げる計画を発表したことを受け、ライアンエアは冬季ダイヤでベルギー発着の２０路線、計１００万席超を削減すると発表した。
